WITCHWIND_SYSTEMS.Title: Witchwind Journal
WITCHWIND_SYSTEMS.NoSections: Every section is switched off in this world's settings.

quests.Name: Quests tab
quests.Hint: Show the Quests tab, and the quest tracker, for everyone in this world.

journal.Name: Journal tab
journal.Hint: Show the Journal tab, where players and the GM write and share notes, for everyone in this world.

maps.Name: Maps tab
maps.Hint: Show the Maps tab, with the GM's maps and everyone's markers, for everyone in this world.

factions.Name: Standing tab
factions.Hint: Show the Standing tab, with each faction and its standing, and each character’s titles, for everyone in this world.

letters.Name: Letters tab
letters.Hint: Show the Letters tab, with the letters, books, notices and orders the GM hands out, for everyone in this world.

merchants.Name: Merchants tab
merchants.Hint: Show the Merchants tab, with each merchant’s wares and prices, for everyone in this world.

bestiary.Name: Bestiary tab
bestiary.Hint: Show the Bestiary tab, with the creatures the party has met and what it has learned about each, for everyone in this world.

notices.Name: Notice board tab
notices.Hint: Show the notice board, with contracts and bounties by region, for everyone in this world.

PlayerNotes.Name: Players can write in the journal
PlayerNotes.Hint: Let players add notes to the Journal tab, and edit or delete their own. The GM can always write notes.

PlayerPins.Name: Players can place map markers
PlayerPins.Hint: Let players place markers on maps, and move or delete their own. The GM can always place markers.

Announce.Name: Announce quest updates
Announce.Hint: When a quest starts, changes, is completed or failed, or a character rises in a faction, show it across the top of each player's screen as in the Elder Scrolls games.

Tracker.Name: Show the quest tracker
Tracker.Hint: Keep the quests you're tracking, and what's left to do in each, in a small card on your screen. This only changes your own view.

open.Name: Sound: book opens
open.Hint: Played when the book opens. Pick any audio file on the server, such as one you have uploaded.

page.Name: Sound: page turns
page.Hint: Played on each new tab or entry.

page2.Name: Sound: page turns (second)
page2.Hint: A second page turn; when both are set, each turn picks one of them at random.

quest.Name: Sound: quest updates
quest.Hint: Played with the banners for quests started, updated, completed or failed, and for faction promotions.

Volume.Name: Sound volume
Volume.Hint: How loud the book and quest sounds are for you. Set it to zero to turn them off. This only changes your own sound.

QuestPopups.Name: Quest pop-ups
QuestPopups.Hint: When a quest is added, completed or failed, show a pop-up to continue past, as in Oblivion. Turn off to see a banner across the top instead. This only changes your own view.

SheetRenown.Name: Renown on character sheets
SheetRenown.Hint: Show a character’s titles and faction ranks in the sidebar of their dnd5e sheet. This only changes your own view.

Calendar.Name: World calendar
Calendar.Hint: Use the Xerseraya calendar for the world: seven days to the week (Dawnwake to Stillhour) and twelve months of thirty days (First Light to Last Light). Choose Foundry’s own to keep the default calendar or another calendar module’s. Foundry reloads when this changes.

Party.Name: Party frame
Party.Hint: Show the party frame at the left of the screen: each character’s portrait, name, hit points and temporary hit points. Each player chooses for themselves.

PartyScale.Name: Party frame size
PartyScale.Hint: How large the party frame is. The − and + buttons on the frame change it too.

PartyName.Name: Party name
PartyName.Hint: The name at the top of the party frame, for everyone. Leave it empty to use the primary party’s name, or Party. The GM can also click the name on the frame to change it.

Keys.party: Show or hide the party frame

Errors.NoGM: A GM needs to be connected to upload pictures for you.
Errors.NoAnswer: The GM didn't answer in time. Try again in a moment.
Errors.TooLarge: That picture is too large to send. Try a smaller one.
Errors.NoPermission: You don't have permission to see that.
Errors.FileType: Drop a picture, or a .txt, .md or .html file.

Quests.GiverPlaceholder: A name, or drop an actor here
Quests.NothingYet: Nothing has been written about this quest yet.
Quests.StartHint: No quests here yet. Use New to write the first.
Quests.DragHint: Drag quests to reorder them, or onto a group heading to move them

Journal.PrivateHint: Only the writer and the GM can see this
Journal.DropHint: Drop a picture or text file here to make a note
Journal.StartHint: No notes yet. Use New, or drop a picture or text file onto this page.

Modes.notesHint: Session notes the table writes and shares
Modes.lettersHint: In-world letters, books, notices and orders the GM hands out

Maps.Choose: Choose a picture already on the server
Maps.EmptyGM: No maps yet. Upload a picture, or drop one here.
Maps.DropHint: Drop pictures here to add maps
Maps.Fit: Fit the map to the window
Maps.PlaceHint: Click the map to place your marker. You can also double-click anywhere.
Maps.DragHint: Drag the marker to move it.
Maps.StartHint: Upload a map to begin. New maps start hidden; reveal one when the party should see it.
Maps.NoneHint: The GM hasn't shared any maps yet.
Maps.PinTextPlaceholder: Anything worth remembering about this place

Factions.StartHint: No factions yet. Use New to write the first.
Factions.NoneHint: The party hasn't heard of any factions yet.
Factions.DropHint: Drop actors here to add members
Factions.NoMembers: None of the party belong to this faction.
Factions.NoMembersGM: No members yet. Drop actors onto this page, or add the party in the editor.
Factions.PersonalHint: Personal standing, -100 to 100. Leave empty to use the party’s.

Editor.Title: Title
Editor.Name: Name
Editor.ImageHint: Upload a picture, choose one from the server, or drop one here.
Editor.ImageHintRelay: Upload a picture or drop one here; a connected GM's client stores it for you.
Editor.ObjectivesHint: What the party needs to do. Hidden objectives stay secret until you reveal them from the quest page.
Editor.LogHint: Journal entries tell the story of the quest as it's played, newest first, as in the Elder Scrolls games. Write a hidden entry ahead of time and reveal it later.
Editor.EntryPlaceholder: What happened, in the party's words…
Editor.HiddenEntry: Hide this entry from players for now
Editor.RewardsDrop: Drop items here from the sidebar or a compendium
Editor.GMNotesHint: Only GMs can see these notes.
Editor.SharedNoteHint: Turn this off to keep the note between you and the GM.
Editor.SharedPinHint: Turn this off to keep the marker between you and the GM.
Editor.SharedPinHintGM: Turn this off to keep the marker for GMs only.
Editor.StandingHint: From -100 (hated) to 100 (revered). The party sees the tier, such as Friendly or Hostile.
Editor.RanksHint: One rank per line, lowest first.
Editor.MembersDrop: Drop actors here to add them as members
Editor.GroupsHint: Name your quest groups and put them in order. Leave a default group’s name blank to keep its usual name. Quests in a removed group move to the first.

Visibility.Title: Who can see it
Visibility.OnlyHint: Only these players (none ticked means everyone):
Visibility.Limited: Only some players can see this

Data.Title: Backups and Imports
Data.Hint: Download all quests, notes, maps, markers and factions as one file, restore one, or turn a folder of journal entries into quests.
Data.BackupHint: {quests} quests, {notes} notes, {maps} maps, {pins} markers and {factions} factions, with your quest groups.
Data.RestoreHint: Load a backup file downloaded from here, from this world or another.
Data.Replace: Replace everything with the backup (untick to add it to what’s here)
Data.JournalHint: Turns each journal entry in a folder into a quest: its first page becomes the details, each further page a step, and checklist items objectives. Folders named Completed or Failed set the status. Works with Simple Quest’s folders.
Data.NoFolders: There are no journal folders in this world.
Data.BadFile: That isn’t a Witchwind Systems backup.
Data.ConfirmReplace: Replace all quests, notes, maps, markers and factions with the backup from {date}? This can’t be undone.
Data.ConfirmMerge: Add the backup from {date} to what’s here? Entries in both are replaced by the backup’s.
Data.NothingToImport: There are no journal entries in that folder.

Letters.StartHint: No letters yet. Use New Letter to write the first. It can arrive today or on a later day.
Letters.NoneHint: No letters have reached you yet.
Letters.TitlePlaceholder: To the bearer of the ember-lantern
Letters.ArriveHint: 0 delivers it now. Otherwise it arrives that many days after today ({today}) in the world’s calendar, with a pop-up for whoever it’s for.

Merchants.StartHint: No merchants yet. Use New to add one; new merchants start hidden.
Merchants.NoneHint: No merchants are known to the party yet.
Merchants.RestockHint: On each restock, every ware returns to its usual amount. Leave empty for a merchant who never restocks.
Merchants.StockDrop: Drop items here from the sidebar or a compendium

Bestiary.NoneHint: The party hasn’t met any creatures yet.
Bestiary.StartHint: No creatures yet. Drag a monster from the Monsters compendium onto this page to add it.
Bestiary.DropHint: Drop a monster from the Monsters compendium here to add it
Bestiary.NoSource: This creature wasn’t copied from a compendium, so there’s nothing to refresh it from.
Bestiary.SourceMissing: The compendium entry for this creature can’t be found any more.
Bestiary.EditHint: Lore and tactics are written by you. Each fact on the record is revealed on its own, to everyone or to chosen players.

Notices.RegionsHint: The regions notices are posted under. Renaming one keeps the notices in it. Remove one and its notices are left unfiled.
Notices.NoRegions: Add regions first, with the map button above the board.
Notices.EmptyGM: Nothing pinned up here yet. Use Pin up to post a notice.
Notices.NoneHint: No notices have been pinned up for you yet.
Notices.StartHint: Pick a notice from the board to read it here.
Notices.RewardPlaceholder: 150 gold and a letter of thanks
Notices.ExpiresHint: 0 keeps it up until it’s taken or taken down.
Notices.Taken: You took the contract. It’s in your Quests.
Notices.NotOpen: That notice is no longer open.
Notices.Title: Notice Board

Modes.factionsHint: Each faction, its standing and the party’s ranks in it
Modes.renownHint: Each character’s titles and place in the factions

Party.Title: Party
Party.DragHint: Drag to move the party frame
Party.Collapse: Fold or unfold the party frame
Party.Empty: No party yet. Assign characters to players, or set a primary party.
Party.RenameHint: Shown to everyone at the top of the party frame. Leave it empty to use the default.
